name: atrial septal defect
description: A communication in the atrial septum permitting blood flow between the left and right atria. Descriptors include anatomic subtype, defect size, shunt direction and magnitude, associated right heart changes, and repair status.

attributes.name: presence
attributes.description: Whether an atrial septal defect is identified on the study.

values.name: present
values.description: Defect is seen.

values.name: absent
values.description: No defect identified.

values.name: indeterminate
values.description: Study is suboptimal or equivocal for presence of a defect.

attributes.name: defect type
attributes.description: Anatomic subtype or location of the atrial septal defect.

values.name: secundum
values.description: Ostium secundum location in the fossa ovalis region.

values.name: primum
values.description: Primum type adjacent to the atrioventricular valves.

values.name: sinus venosus
values.description: Sinus venosus type near the superior or inferior caval vein.

values.name: coronary sinus
values.description: Defect involving the coronary sinus region.

values.name: multiple
values.description: More than one separate atrial septal communication.

values.name: unspecified
values.description: Subtype not specified or not clearly characterized.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Maximum diameter of the defect measured on imaging.

attributes.name: shunt direction
attributes.description: Primary direction of blood flow across the defect.

values.name: left to right
values.description: Left-to-right shunt (most common).

values.name: right to left
values.description: Right-to-left shunt (suggests elevated right-sided pressures).

values.name: bidirectional
values.description: Shunt direction varies with cardiac cycle or pressures.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Direction not determinable from study.

attributes.name: qp qs ratio
attributes.description: Estimated pulmonary to systemic flow ratio (Qp:Qs) when available.

attributes.name: hemodynamic significance
attributes.description: Clinical/physiologic impact of the defect based on size, shunt and chamber response.

values.name: insignificant
values.description: Minimal physiologic impact.

values.name: small
values.description: Small shunt with limited hemodynamic effect.

values.name: moderate
values.description: Moderate shunt with some right heart volume load.

values.name: large
values.description: Large shunt with significant right heart dilation or symptomatic impact.

attributes.name: right heart dilation
attributes.description: Degree of right atrial or right ventricular enlargement attributable to the defect.

values.name: none
values.description: No right heart enlargement.

values.name: mild
values.description: Mild right atrial or ventricular enlargement.

values.name: moderate
values.description: Moderate enlargement.

values.name: severe
values.description: Severe enlargement.

attributes.name: closure status
attributes.description: Whether the defect is native, repaired, or contains a closure device.

values.name: native
values.description: No prior repair; native defect present.

values.name: surgically repaired
values.description: Previously repaired surgically.

values.name: device repaired
values.description: Closed previously with a transcatheter device.

values.name: residual defect
values.description: Residual communication after attempted repair.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Repair status not known or not documented.

attributes.name: associated findings
attributes.description: Other cardiac or vascular findings commonly reported with ASD.

values.name: none
values.description: No associated findings.

values.name: right atrial enlargement
values.description: Right atrial enlargement.

values.name: right ventricular enlargement
values.description: Right ventricular enlargement.

values.name: pulmonary hypertension
values.description: Findings suggestive of elevated pulmonary arterial pressure.

values.name: anomalous pulmonary venous return
values.description: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous connection.

values.name: ventricular septal defect
values.description: Coexisting ventricular septal defect.

values.name: paradoxical embolus
values.description: Imaging evidence or clinical concern for paradoxical embolism.

values.name: other
values.description: Other associated cardiac findings.
